indicator_name:
• Household disposable income per capita
  • Composite rate of labour underutilization
  • Proportion of time spent on unpaid domestic and care work
area_description: While well-being is not determined by income alone, sufficient material resources are a necessary condition for people to exercise choice and agency in their lives. Without adequate means, individuals and families are constrained to meeting day-to-day needs. Persistent material deprivation undermines people’s ability to plan, invest in their future, and participate in society fully. Beyond the monetary benefits of employment, work also provides a sense of dignity and self-realization.

footer_fields.label: Note
footer_fields.value: The indicator covers the unemployed, people in the potential labour force (e.g. the hidden reserve) and those who are underemployed in terms of hours – that is, people in employment who would like to work more and are available to do so.
